title: QEC Researcher / Engineer
description: Design and test quantum error-correcting codes and the decoders that run them, from stabilizer-code theory to real-time decoding hardware.

title: Quantum Hardware Engineer
description: Build and characterize qubit devices and their control stack: cryogenics, microwave electronics, calibration and readout.

title: Quantum Software / Compiler Engineer
description: Build the tools that make quantum computers usable: SDKs, compilers, transpilers, simulators and error-mitigation pipelines.

title: Quantum Algorithms & Applications Scientist
description: Research and evaluate quantum algorithms for simulation, optimization and chemistry, and estimate the resources real machines need.

title: Quantum ML Engineer
description: Combine parameterized quantum circuits with machine learning: variational models, quantum kernels and hybrid training systems.

title: Quantum Security & Networking Engineer
description: Deploy post-quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution, and design the links and protocols of the quantum internet.
